create_RNNCell: create a quantized RNN cell with specified input size, hidden size, bias, and weight quantization parameters
create_LSTMCell: create a quantized LSTM cell with input size, hidden size, bias flag, and weight quantization parameter dictionary
create_GRUCell: create a quantized GRU cell with input size, hidden size, bias flag, and weight quantization parameter dictionary
create_LSTM: create a quantized LSTM module with input size, hidden size, number of layers, bias, batch first, dropout, and bidirectional settings
create_GRU: create a quantized GRU module with input size, hidden size, number of layers, bias, batch first, dropout, and bidirectional settings
